newsitem.title: EGYPT: Arafat in Cairo after Hebron handover.
newsitem.headline: Arafat in Cairo after Hebron handover.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat flew into Cairo on Wednesday for talks with Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak after Israel handed over most of the West Bank town of Hebron to the PLO, officials said.
They said Arafat arrived in the early hours of Wednesday from Italy where he held day-long talks with Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi and President Oscar Scalfaro.

Arafat reclaimed Hebron on Sunday after months of bitter negotiations with Israel's right-wing leader Benjamin Netanyahu. The Palestinian leader has said the handover would be a springboard for further Israeli withdrawal from the West Bank.

Egypt, which sees itself as an unofficial sponsor of the Middle East peace process, has supported the Palestinians in their Hebron negotiations and Arafat regularly consults with Mubarak about the peace talks.
